issues.display_title: Issue #1289: Fix Issue Import Tour Return wrong Name, CID, and Location
issues.main_description_html:
Brainstorming File: 2026-06-02-import-tour-by-cid-wrong-data-design.md

Acceptance Criteria

AC-1 — Correct place identity when all override fields are provided

Given a request to POST /tours/import-google that includes cid, place_name, and place_address When the import completes successfully Then the created tour in 0_moderation must have:

  • business_name = the value passed in place_name
  • place_address = the value passed in place_address
  • 1_cid = the value passed in cid

Example: Request includes cid=2626221539385545619, place_name=Arca Boutique Hotel, place_address=West bay Beach, 34101 Bay Islands, Honduras → Tour row has exactly those three values, regardless of what Google Street View photo metadata says.

AC-2 — Backward compatibility when override fields are absent

Given a request to POST /tours/import-google that contains only lat, lng, email (no cid, place_name, or place_address) When the import completes Then the created tour uses place identity derived from Google Street View photo metadata — identical to the behaviour before this fix.

AC-3 — Partial override is ignored (all-or-nothing)

Given a request that includes only one or two of the three override fields (e.g., cid is present but place_name is absent) When the import runs Then the tour falls back to Street View metadata — the partial override is not applied.

AC-4 — Photo content is unaffected by the override

Given a request that includes all three override fields When the import completes Then the panoramas imported into the tour are still the Street View photos fetched from the provided lat/lng coordinates — the override only changes the tour's name, address, and CID, not which photos are imported.

AC-5 — moderation_id is returned on success

Given a valid request with correct lat, lng, email, and Google account connected When the import succeeds (with or without override fields) Then the response is HTTP 200 with { "moderation_id": <number> } in the payload.

AC-6 — Missing lat or lng still returns validation error

Given a request to POST /tours/import-google that omits lat or lng When the request is processed Then the response is HTTP 409 with a validation error — unchanged from existing behaviour.

Note from Developer

This issue arises because TypeSense stores outdated data, as shown in the following image:

This issue can be fixed temporarily by deleting data from typesense and making the system recreate the latest data from google, but this is only temporary, further discussion is needed on how to track outdated data from typesense without burdening google api (to remain cost-effective)

issues.display_title: Issue #1290: Add Response has_main_overlay at Tours List V1
issues.main_description_html:
Brainstorming File: 2026-06-02-list-tours-v1-has-main-overlay-design.md

Acceptance Criteria

AC-1 — File exists → has_main_overlay: true

Given a tour whose overlay.json exists at /data/moderation/{userId}/{1_cid}/overlay/{tourId}/overlay.json When GET /v1/tours/list is called Then that tour item in the response contains "has_main_overlay": true

AC-2 — File absent → has_main_overlay: false

Given a tour that has never been saved in the overlay editor (no overlay.json file on disk) When GET /v1/tours/list is called Then that tour item contains "has_main_overlay": false

AC-3 — No overlay record → has_main_overlay: false

Given a tour that has no row in hosted_tours.tours (getTourOverlayInfo() returns null or tour_id is 0) When GET /v1/tours/list is called Then that tour item contains "has_main_overlay": false (no filesystem check is attempted)

AC-4 — has_main_overlay is independent of overlay_active

Given a tour that has an overlay.json on disk but foverlay_active is not '1' (overlay configured but not published) When GET /v1/tours/list is called Then the response contains "overlay_active": false AND "has_main_overlay": true simultaneously

And given a tour where foverlay_active is '1' (published) but the overlay.json file has been deleted from disk Then the response contains "overlay_active": true AND "has_main_overlay": false simultaneously

AC-5 — Field is always present

Given any tour in the list (with or without overlay info) When GET /v1/tours/list is called Then every tour item includes has_main_overlay as a boolean — never absent, never null

AC-6 — Encrypted response also includes the field

Given a request with enc: true header When GET /v1/tours/list returns an encrypted envelope Then the decrypted list_tours array still contains has_main_overlay in each tour item (the field is set at the Action level, before encryption)
